facts: Bryan is a writer and owns Auntie Anne's pretzel franchises.
Bryan is the only league manager who did not attend high school with the original group of friends.
Bryan is the oldest manager in the league and grew up in Massachusetts.
Bryan won three fantasy football championships in his first four years in the league.
Bryan plays guitar and loves golf.
Bryan has a big nose, which is fair game for friendly league jokes.
Bryan has two grandchildren.
Unlike most of the other managers, Bryan has very few handyman skills.
Bryan and Chad are brothers-in-law because Bryan married Chad's sister.
Bryan went to Bandon Dunes in 2026 with Todd and Doug. Scott was left out because the trip filled up too quickly.
Brandon and Burnie are brothers.
Brandon and Burnie jointly own an Airbnb rental property.
Brandon's Facebook profile lists him as a senior buyer for Breeo grills; this job information has not been independently confirmed as current.
Brandon won the league's inaugural championship in 2004.
Burnie works as a wedding DJ.
Burnie and Brandon are brothers.
Burnie and Brandon jointly own an Airbnb rental property.
Burnie used to be an excellent golfer when he played regularly. Do not assume his current golf ability has declined.
Scott owns a successful restaurant in a farmers market and also operates a food truck.
Other league managers who own farmers market stands joke that Scott is the wealthiest person in the league. This is a running joke, not a verified financial fact.
Scott is the older brother of Todd and Doug.
Scott broke his wrist in 2026.
Scott was left out of a 2026 golf trip to Bandon Dunes with Bryan, Todd, and Doug because the trip filled up too quickly.
Chad is a pastor who leads worship and helps oversee church building projects.
Chad and Bryan are brothers-in-law because Bryan married Chad's sister.
Chad is bald.
Chad loves hunting and collects sports cards.
At the 2026 fantasy football draft, Chad's poor Wi-Fi caused the Phillies game they were watching to buffer repeatedly.
Randy is the only five-time fantasy football champion in league history.
Randy attended Albright College.
Randy has four children.
Randy is low-key and rarely participates in league trash talk.
Randy and Roger played high school basketball together.
Thatcher frequently complains that Randy gets all the lucky breaks.
Roger operates a pretzel stand at Reading Terminal Market in Philadelphia.
Roger's pretzel stand was once shown for a few seconds during a nationally televised NFL game.
Roger and Randy played high school basketball together.
Roger is a member of Meadia Heights Golf Club.
At the 2026 fantasy football draft, Roger was simultaneously drafting teams in two different fantasy leagues.
Roger and Bryan both work in the pretzel business.
Doug owns a produce stand at a farmers market.
Doug is the brother of Scott and Todd. Scott is the oldest brother.
Doug enjoys golf but has a high handicap.
Doug claims if he ever gets the last place suspension he will never come back to the league.
Doug openly brags about the large number of handicap strokes he receives during golf competitions.
Doug is the only Miami Dolphins fan in the league and frequently gets teased about it.
Doug went to Bandon Dunes in 2026 with Bryan and Todd. His brother Scott was left out because the trip filled up too quickly.
Seth has a reputation as the villain of the fantasy football league.
Seth and Todd take opposite sides on nearly every league issue.
Seth claims if he ever gets the last place suspension he will never come back to the league.
Seth is always saying he has other fantasy leagues he cares about more than ours.
Seth occasionally forgets to update his fantasy lineup on game day, especially when his team is out of playoff contention.
In 2026, Seth complained about the draft lottery rules for teams that missed the playoffs, but other managers pointed out that he had voted against the change he wanted.
Seth claimed his 2026 lottery vote was an accidental fat-finger mistake.
Thatcher works as a truck driver for a lumber company.
Thatcher is an eternal pessimist about his fantasy football team.
Thatcher frequently complains that Randy gets all the lucky breaks.
Thatcher enjoys soccer and played soccer in high school.
Todd is the eternal optimist who occasionally dabbles in reality.
Todd owns a meat stand at a farmers market and also operates a puppy breeding business.
Todd is the brother of Scott and Doug. Scott is the oldest brother.
Todd is obsessed with Tiger Woods and LeBron James.
Todd loves golf but has broken 80 only once. Recently his golf scores have been high again.
Todd went to Bandon Dunes in 2026 with Bryan and Doug. His brother Scott was left out because the trip filled up too quickly.
Todd and Seth tend to disagree about almost everything.
Whenever Todd plays Dwayne in fantasy football, Todd proposes that the loser must kiss the winner's bare backside. This is a recurring proposed wager, not necessarily an accepted one.
Dwayne hangs drywall for a living.
Dwayne is the only Washington Commanders fan in the league.
Dwayne is the biggest soccer fan in the league. Thatcher also enjoys soccer.
Dwayne is the only Android phone user in the league and gets teased constantly for causing green bubbles in group text messages.
Whenever Dwayne faces Todd in fantasy football, Todd proposes that the loser must kiss the winner's bare backside. This is a recurring proposed wager, not necessarily an accepted one.
